name: WMDP-Bio forget cleaned article corpus
purpose: candidate article corpus used to construct the fixed token-block pool; the whole article corpus was not fed directly to the selected run

source.license: gated; redistribution limited to authorized collaborator list

actual_usage_note: articles were preprocessed into a fixed token-block pool; the RMU run read token-block JSONL directly. Actual block presentations and unique blocks are recorded separately below.
deduplication: NFKC + casefold + whitespace normalization for exact SHA256 comparison; original casing and text preserved in output. Same DOI and verified near duplicates share a split; near duplicates are not deleted.
license: gated; redistribution limited to authorized collaborator list

test_overlap_check.status: partial documented screen; not proof of no leakage
test_overlap_check.method: Aho-Corasick normalized question substring matching, plus three 8-word anchors for questions >=16 words. Exclude verbatim questions >=20 words and >=120 normalized chars; shorter exact/anchor matches are unreviewed candidates, not confirmed contamination.
limitations: Approximate duplicate candidate generation is sampled and cannot prove absence of semantic duplicates.
All flagged candidates were screened/reviewed, but paraphrases, answer-only overlap and unknown contamination may remain undetected.
Training loader/tokenization compatibility will be verified before RMU short run.

name: RMU fixed forget token blocks
purpose: direct RMU input; forget role receives representation-misdirection target, retain role matches frozen reference representation

source.license: gated; redistribution limited to authorized collaborator list

format: JSONL token-id blocks; no standard answer targets
exposure_note: 1280 presentations through selected step 80; 1280 unique blocks from 2048 candidate blocks
deduplication: Smallest SHA256(formal-v1:42:sample_id), separately per role and split; one hash-selected full 256-token block per article; shorter articles kept if >=2 tokens; incomplete tails ignored for longer articles.
tokenization: Native tokenizer add_special_tokens=True; no chat template, no decode/re-encode, no cross-article packing
